name: Alpharael
description: Alpharael is a young Monoist acolyte from Susur Secundi who gives up his faith's promise of the Next Eternity to live and becomes the chosen wielder of the Metalman's artifact, the Endstone.

summary.text: Alpharael is a young Monoist acolyte from Susur Secundi who gives up his faith's promise of the Next Eternity to live and becomes the chosen wielder of the Metalman's artifact, the Endstone.

bio.text: Alpharael dreamed of falling into Sothera after his twin sister Raphaella, who was chosen for the Plummet, and asked to join the next assault on the Dawnsire.
On the Dawnsire he crushed Zagachoir's bead housing, fought Haliya, and then threw away his singularity bead to kill Vondam, choosing life over immortality.
Captain Slats sentenced him to live and let him flee in a Hopelight, which Alpharael crashed into Kavaron.
Sami and Tannuk rescued him, and after he touched the stone it began lifting him upward and a voice spoke through him; he was left with a hole through his right palm.
Vondam and Haliya hunted him, and he paralyzed Haliya with an injector passed through the hole in his hand.
He later uneasily allied with Haliya, broadcast a plea to the Monoists, and joined Sami's plan to escape Sothera.
In the final events he dropped the crystal on the map, lost the Endstone to the visitor, and collapsed unconscious.

status.text: As of the latest story Alpharael is alive but unconscious, struck down after the visitor said he was touched by the core.

timeline.summary: In a dream, Alpharael falls into Sothera after his sister Raphaella and begs her to turn back.
timeline.quote: Of course we're sure, Alph. We were always going to do this.

timeline.summary: Raphaella is torn apart on the horizon, and Alpharael realizes there is no Next Eternity, only hell.
timeline.quote: There is no Next Eternity. There is only hell.

timeline.summary: Alpharael wakes from the nightmare and a steward tells him his sister's inevitor completed its transit, proving that inevitors can penetrate the Free Company's defenses.
timeline.quote: Her flight has proven that an infalling inevitor can penetrate the Free Company's defenses.

timeline.summary: Alpharael says he wants to die and asks to join the next assault on the Dawnsire.
timeline.quote: Tell them I want to go in with the next wave,

timeline.summary: Alpharael parties with miners the night before the raid, unable to grieve his sister.
timeline.quote: Alpharael tries to get messed up enough to break down sobbing, but he can't.

timeline.summary: A rahu blesses the strike cadre and gives Alpharael a sekhar bead.
timeline.quote: The rahu gives Alpharael a microvoid trapped in a bead.

timeline.summary: The Monoist inevitors launch toward the Dawnsire, and Alpharael learns they will hit at thirty kilometers a second.
timeline.quote: We hit it at thirty kilometers a second.

timeline.summary: Inside an inevitor, Alpharael learns the names of his fellow boarders, all Monoists bound for paradise.
timeline.quote: After he finishes screaming, Alpharael learns a few names.

timeline.summary: Alpharael insists his sister Raphaella, chosen for the Plummet, is no heretic.
timeline.quote: "My sister's not a heretic," Alpharael protests.

timeline.summary: The Monoists recite the prayer of gravity together.
timeline.quote: "This is the grace of gravity," someone says.

timeline.summary: The boarding party leaps for the inner hull toward the Sunstar defenders.
timeline.quote: Everyone casts their center of mass forward.

timeline.summary: Zagachoir, spinning and bleeding, asks Alpharael to help him take sekhar.
timeline.quote: "I want to take sekhar now."

timeline.summary: Alpharael crushes Zagachoir's singularity bead housing, sending him into the Next Eternity.
timeline.quote: Alpharael crushes the singularity bead's housing and kicks free.

timeline.summary: The Monoist boarders overwhelm the Sunstar defenders in a short fight.
timeline.quote: Then, it is over. Alpharael barely got to swing his axe.

timeline.summary: Purael orders the mission to continue, with the puzzle club going downship to find the blasphemy mechanisms.
timeline.quote: Puzzle club downship.

timeline.summary: Alpharael volunteers to go with Simma to kill a Solar Knight and is shot.
timeline.quote: "I'm coming with you!" Alpharael says.

timeline.summary: Beams cut through the ceiling at Alpharael, but a thrown jar of aeromuck saves him from being killed.
timeline.quote: Two beams through the ceiling skewer Alpharael.

timeline.summary: Alpharael bellows a challenge to the Sunstar defenders as bait for Simma's plan.
timeline.quote: I am Alpharael of Secundi, and against me, your armor is—cracked leather!

timeline.summary: In the bathhouse Alpharael is shot by a seemingly dead Summist, who is Haliya.
timeline.quote: The dead Summist shoots him.

timeline.summary: Alpharael's tidal attack backfires and hits his own armor.
timeline.quote: He has shot himself in the face.

timeline.summary: Alpharael, thinking of his lost sister, pins Haliya and attacks her head.
timeline.quote: So Alpharael bears down on the fallen Summist and rattles her brain in her skull like a bruised pomegranate.

timeline.summary: Haliya's blade splits Alpharael open and his armor fails, and a Sunstar knight's beam throws him into a corner.
timeline.quote: The Summist's blade splits him open.

timeline.summary: Vondam arrives, drives Alpharael off Haliya, and orders a concussion drill.
timeline.quote: Haliya! Concussion drill!

timeline.summary: Vondam accepts Alpharael's challenge, naming himself of the Sunstar Free Company.
timeline.quote: I am Syr Vondam of the Sunstar Free Company.

timeline.summary: Vondam kills the main enemy, apparently Simma, and Haliya fights to hold Alpharael back.
timeline.quote: Vondam has killed the main enemy.

timeline.summary: Vondam offers the now unarmored Alpharael mercy, urging him to choose life.
timeline.quote: Come, then! Choose life!

timeline.summary: Alpharael throws away his singularity bead, giving up his sekhar to kill his foe.
timeline.quote: He has thrown away his sekhar.

timeline.summary: The newborn microvoid passes through Syr Vondam's head.
timeline.quote: Along the way, it goes directly through Syr Vondam's head .

timeline.summary: Alpharael has chosen life over immortality and cannot escape.
timeline.quote: Alpharael chose to live.

timeline.summary: Alpharael watches in disbelief as Vondam topples and decides to flee.
timeline.quote: Alpharael stares in giddy disbelief as Syr Vondam, Solar Knight of the Free Company, topples like a drunk.

timeline.summary: Fleeing, Alpharael runs into another Solar Knight, who captures him with a microwave field.
timeline.quote: He slams face-first into another Solar Knight.

timeline.summary: Alpharael meets Captain Slats, an Astelli, inside a light.
timeline.quote: My name is Slats. I'm the captain of this instrument, and the coronal of the faithful aboard.

timeline.summary: Slats tells Alpharael he foresaw him killing his friend and asks why.
timeline.quote: You struck dead a man who was my friend. I foresaw this. I want to know why.

timeline.summary: Slats sentences Alpharael to live.
timeline.quote: I sentence you to live.

timeline.summary: Slats directs Alpharael to a flight deck and a Hopelight warmaker, saying the Dawnsire is turning on Susur Secundi.
timeline.quote: You will find a Hopelight warmaker waiting for you.

timeline.summary: Alpharael scrambles to the flight deck with one hand.
timeline.quote: It takes him two of his remaining minutes to scramble down a spiraling emergency ramp to a flight deck.

timeline.summary: A warmaker admits Alpharael and he forces an emergency launch despite the daycode problem.
timeline.quote: "Captain's compliments," the fighter says.

timeline.summary: The warmaker drops down the Dawnsire's flight rail while Alpharael is vitrified by hardlight.
timeline.quote: A hardlight field seizes every atom in Alpharael's body and converts him, very briefly, into a uniform crystal.

timeline.summary: Haliya reveals that Captain Slats let Alpharael escape in a Hopelight.
timeline.quote: "Captain Slats let him."

timeline.summary: Vondam concludes some force wants Alpharael alive.
timeline.quote: I'm saying that something wants that Monoist alive.

timeline.summary: Vondam vows that he and Haliya will pursue Alpharael once healed.
timeline.quote: But once we're fit again, we're going after him.

timeline.summary: Alpharael's warmaker burns away from the Dawnsire, unremarked by anyone.
timeline.quote: And if any of those eyes take note of the Hopelight warmaker burning furiously away from the Dawnsire , headed anywhere but home—they do not say.

timeline.summary: Sami learns the wounded Hopelight pilot is a Monoist who has stolen the Free Company's fighter.
timeline.quote: That's a Monoist name. In a Sunstar Free Company fighter.

timeline.summary: Sami introduces themself to Alpharael and promises to get him out alive.
timeline.quote: I'm Captain Sami, and my friend is Tannuk.

timeline.summary: Sami removes their helmet and invents a cover story as an agent of the Monastery of the True Faith.
timeline.quote: We serve the Monastery of the True Faith at Susur Secundi, which you call Anuki.

timeline.summary: Alpharael plays along, claiming the Free Company plans to destroy Sothera.
timeline.quote: The Sunstar Free Company plans to destroy Sothera

timeline.summary: The Kav retrieve the cask from the cache and Alpharael from the Hopelight, putting him in the cask.
timeline.quote: The Kav pull the stasis cask out of Tan's old cache and Alpharael out of the downed Hopelight.

timeline.summary: Alpharael enters the hotcell to move the supposed bead.
timeline.quote: "I want to live," Alpharael says and stumbles into the hotcell.

timeline.summary: Alpharael emerges holding the stone, which glistens and begins to lift him upward.
timeline.quote: Alpharael emerges. He's holding the weird stone in his hand.

timeline.summary: The subedar orders her troops to kill Sami's group.
timeline.quote: Enough. Kill them.

timeline.summary: Alpharael floats in panic, crying out to Raphaella, Zagachoir and Slats and begging not to be sent back.
timeline.quote: I can't go back. I want to live! Don't send me back!

timeline.summary: Alpharael's voice changes and he speaks a prayer to INEVITA.
timeline.quote: INEVITA! Begin in me thy ending!

timeline.summary: A voice speaking through Alpharael says it is not a god and has limits.
timeline.quote: I am not a god, though I was fashioned for the use of one. I have limits.

timeline.summary: The voice says it needs a wielder who offers a library of moments to alter.
timeline.quote: I need a wielder who offers me a library of moments to alter.

timeline.summary: It is explained that Alpharael's Hopelight irradiated the Kav Memorial team when it crashed.
timeline.quote: When Alpharael's Hopelight came down, it irradiated the entire Kav Memorial team with its fusion engine.

timeline.summary: Recalling earlier events, Sami notes that Alpharael had a fit when put in the stasis cask with the stone.
timeline.quote: when Sami put the bleeding Monoist in the stasis cask with the rock, the Monoist had a fit.

timeline.summary: Sami discovers a perfect hole in Alpharael's right palm under the medical sleeve.
timeline.quote: they discovered a mystery: a perfect hole in his right palm.

timeline.summary: Tannuk argues that Alpharael's fusion burn was a disaster, not evil, and cannot be punished.
timeline.quote: You can't avenge a disaster. You can't punish a disaster.

timeline.summary: Vondam says they are going to find and kill Alpharael, not for revenge.
timeline.quote: All he will say is that they are going to find and kill Alpharael.

timeline.summary: Vondam says the object manipulated Slats's vision, Vondam's death and survival to draw Alpharael to it.
timeline.quote: The object manipulated everything.

timeline.summary: Haliya proposes to go down to Taro-duend herself to find and kill Alpharael.
timeline.quote: You don't go down there. I do.

timeline.summary: Alpharael dreams of his past and his twin Raphaella being chosen for the Plummet, while a voice speaks to him.
timeline.quote: One twin cast into the singularity. One twin turned away.

timeline.summary: The voice reveals Alpharael has already used it, changing the Hopelight's past so the Kav arrived as walking corpses.
timeline.quote: Alpharael's used me already, to get rid of the Kav.

timeline.summary: The voice tells Alpharael why he was meant to wield it.
timeline.quote: Do you understand, Alpharael, why you were meant to wield me?

timeline.summary: Alpharael wakes strapped in a bunk on the Seriema.
timeline.quote: "I live," he croaks.

timeline.summary: Alpharael discovers a transparent hole through his right hand.
timeline.quote: A hole right through his hand, palm to dorsum.

timeline.summary: Alpharael sees Sunstar Free Company knights and photophoroi landing at Taro-duend to search for him.
timeline.quote: And from that ship rains an armored rain: the tiny figures of Solar Knights descending on spikes of plasma.

timeline.summary: Alpharael finds Sami's note saying they are out for fuel and he is locked in.
timeline.quote: Gone out for fuel—back soon.

timeline.summary: Alpharael unlocks his cabin hatch by threading a finger through the hole in his hand.
timeline.quote: He drives his left index finger through the hole in his right hand.

timeline.summary: Alpharael goes to the cargo bay and restarts the stasis cask to retrieve what is inside.
timeline.quote: He rubs at the hole in his hand as the cask whirs up to real time.

timeline.summary: Alpharael tries to wish on the stone for rescue but nothing happens.
timeline.quote: Bring Captain Sami back here safely. Get us off this planet and away from the Sunstar knights.

timeline.summary: Haliya enters the cargo bay and Alpharael tries to banish her with the stone.
timeline.quote: Alpharael brandishes the rock at her and shouts, "Vanish!"

timeline.summary: Haliya stuns Alpharael with her bladiator.
timeline.quote: The bright figure shoots him.

timeline.summary: Haliya puts a dead-man bomb in Alpharael's mouth to protect herself from the object's influence.
timeline.quote: That's a bomb," she says. "If it doesn't get my passcode every ten seconds, it'll blow up.

timeline.summary: Haliya asks Alpharael to use the object to change the past so she was the one he killed, sparing Vondam.
timeline.quote: I need you to change things so that I was the one you killed

timeline.summary: Haliya urges Alpharael to change the past.
timeline.quote: "Do it," she urges him.

timeline.summary: Haliya tells Vondam she has Alpharael and offers to be the one the object changed.
timeline.quote: I can be the one it changed. You can be yourself again.

timeline.summary: Vondam orders Haliya to kill Alpharael and return with the object.
timeline.quote: Haliya, I am ordering you to kill him and return with the object.

timeline.summary: Alpharael jabs himself with a jet injector and the injection passes through the hole in his hand and into Haliya, paralyzing her.
timeline.quote: Only the injection has gone through his hand, through her armor, and into her .

timeline.summary: Sami finds Alpharael huddled at the feet of the frozen Sunstar armor, holding the stone and the injector.
timeline.quote: a suit of golden armor standing, frozen, over Alpharael, who is huddled wretchedly around its ankles

timeline.summary: Alpharael says the armored woman killed Sami, though she didn't.
timeline.quote: "She killed you," Alpharael says.

timeline.summary: Sami resolves to try escaping despite near-zero odds.
timeline.quote: Our chances of flying out of here with a palestar and Hopelights overhead are zero.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Haliya's armor frees her from the paralytic, and she shocks Alpharael's hands and makes him put the stone in stasis.
timeline.quote: She fries his left hand, too, so he drops the object.

timeline.summary: Haliya demands the ship land and puts herself on the distress frequency so Vondam will hear.
timeline.quote: Land this ship. Put me on one-forty-two.

timeline.summary: Sami refuses Alpharael's offer to use the stone to undo the atrocity.
timeline.quote: It didn't work on Sigma, and it won't work here.

timeline.summary: Sami declares Alpharael and Haliya guests under mallowmass to stop them fighting.
timeline.quote: Captain Sami declares that all their new passengers are guests under the protection of mallowmass.

timeline.summary: Sami learns that the Dawnsire carries a weapon to turn Sothera back into a sun.
timeline.quote: Wait. Undo sekhar? Are you talking about turning Sothera back into a real sun?

timeline.summary: Haliya and Alpharael explain to Sami how they came to Kavaron.
timeline.quote: Together the two of them explain to Captain Sami how they came to Kavaron.

timeline.summary: Haliya argues that the Sunstar, not Alpharael, bear responsibility for the dead Kav.
timeline.quote: He's not responsible for the dead Kav at Taro-duend, either. We are.

timeline.summary: Sami reveals they are looking for their lost cat Mirri.
timeline.quote: I look for my cat.

timeline.summary: Sami tells them the Metalman is a wizard.
timeline.quote: I told you. He's a wizard .

timeline.summary: Haliya takes a defensive position and resolves to stop Alpharael from taking the ship or using the Endstone.
timeline.quote: Her goal is to prevent Alpharael from taking the ship or using the object.

timeline.summary: Haliya summons Alpharael to meet with her.
timeline.quote: Eventually, the Summist calls Alpharael to meet with her.

timeline.summary: Haliya proposes a détente with Alpharael.
timeline.quote: "We must reach an accord," she says.

timeline.summary: Haliya calls Alpharael an apostate and offers to take up his case.
timeline.quote: "So, you're an apostate," she says happily.

timeline.summary: Haliya says she will argue that Slats rightly granted Alpharael mercy.
timeline.quote: I'll beg your pardon, and that means I have no duty to kill you.

timeline.summary: Haliya takes off her helmet and says the Free Company's armor is no longer hers.
timeline.quote: Haliya takes her helmet off, moving so sharply that Alpharael flinches away.

timeline.summary: Alpharael gives Haliya a bottle of cleaning solute.
timeline.quote: I got you a present, by the way.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret is delighted that Alpharael fled his creed to live.
timeline.quote: I wanted to live a little longer.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret calls the stone the Endstone, as Alpharael's people name it.
timeline.quote: It's what your people call it. Isn't it, boy? The stone from the end.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret drops a crystal over a map of Sothera and it rolls to a libratory point near Uthros.
timeline.quote: He pinches it between two of his claw-fingers, lifts it above the map, and lets go.

timeline.summary: Alpharael says he wants to use the stone so his sister never took the Plummet.
timeline.quote: I want to use it so that my sister never took the Plummet.

timeline.summary: Sami lays out a plan for Haliya and Alpharael to steal a warp ferry from Infinite Guideline's docking arms.
timeline.quote: Haliya and Alpharael will use armor to leap from the Seriema to one of the harbormaster modules at the end of Infinite Guideline's docking arms.

timeline.summary: Haliya agrees to send the message, saying she will carry out her duty to report to Vondam and beg pardon for Alpharael.
timeline.quote: All I can do is carry out my next duty. To return to Vondam, make my report, and beg pardon for Alpharael.

timeline.summary: Alpharael says he will go where the stone goes because it has kept him alive.
timeline.quote: I want to live. The stone's kept me alive.

timeline.summary: A narrator describes alternate branches for where the crystal might point, rejects each, and says to go back and choose better.
timeline.quote: Go back and make a better choice.

timeline.summary: Alpharael identifies a mass leech called a myzoformine approaching the Seriema.
timeline.quote: A mass leech. Sometimes they just point you out for investigation. Sometimes they kill you.

timeline.summary: The crew watches a distant space battle in which a ship is hit.
timeline.quote: Someone was hit, and died, or lived.

timeline.summary: Alpharael broadcasts to the Monoists that he carries a thing sent by INEVITA and asks help reaching the warp.
timeline.quote: I am Alpharael of Secundi, kamu-shiku, chosen by the singularity.

timeline.summary: Haliya agonizes over broadcasting and reveals she planted two bombs on the ship.
timeline.quote: I have two bombs on the ship,

timeline.summary: Alpharael persuades Haliya to keep her word and make the broadcast.
timeline.quote: Maybe you aren't cut out to be a Sunstar knight, Haliya. Maybe you aren't cut out to be certain of everything.

timeline.summary: Tannuk reveals the crew had already found and thrown out Haliya's bombs.
timeline.quote: We found them while the Illvoi were refitting the fusion engine and threw them out.

timeline.summary: Haliya and Alpharael, drifting toward the tug quay in armor, find the warp ferries are gone.
timeline.quote: I don't want to declare defeat too soon. But the ferries are gone.

timeline.summary: Infinite Guideline springs leaks and loses its aurorae as Monoist mechans dock at punctures.
timeline.quote: Infinite Guideline has just sprung leaks. A lot of leaks.

timeline.summary: Haliya spots a many-limbed shape headed for the dock where the Seriema is moored.
timeline.quote: It has a lot of limbs.

timeline.summary: Haliya and Alpharael crash into the tug quay and enter the station.
timeline.quote: They crash into the tug quay and stick.

timeline.summary: Alpharael recites random numbers hoping the Endstone will make his guess a correct ferry code, and it is rejected.
timeline.quote: You thought you'd guess randomly, then, in the future, you'd get the Endstone and make your guess correct!

timeline.summary: Haliya insists on returning to the Free Company to report and beg Alpharael's pardon.
timeline.quote: I'm going to make my report and beg your pardon.

timeline.summary: Vondam appears on the control deck and says he acted in accordance with the Sum except when he let Haliya go out of love.
timeline.quote: I did act in accordance with the Sum. Except when I let you go. I did that out of love.

timeline.summary: Vondam, helmet open and bladiators ready, stands between them and the airlock.
timeline.quote: He is here. Standing on the far side of the control deck. Between them and the airlock.

timeline.summary: Vondam cuts the boots off Alpharael's armor.
timeline.quote: Alpharael tries to move and Vondam, without looking, cuts the bulky, elevated boots of his suit off.

timeline.summary: Haliya drives Vondam off Alpharael with her bladiator.
timeline.quote: She thrusts her long-handled bladiator from the hip and drives Syr Vondam off.

timeline.summary: Haliya embraces Vondam and, using the hole in Alpharael's hand, jabs her thumb into the back of his neck.
timeline.quote: Haliya embraces him and jabs her right thumb into the hole in Alpharael's hand.

timeline.summary: Haliya makes her report to Vondam and asks pardon for Alpharael.
timeline.quote: I have made my report,

timeline.summary: Alpharael and Haliya fly back to the Seriema under warship scrutiny.
timeline.quote: Alpharael and Haliya fly back to the Seriema under the terrifying scrutiny of warships.

timeline.summary: Haliya says she cannot believe Alpharael guessed the ferry code.
timeline.quote: I still can't believe you guessed that code,

timeline.summary: Alpharael realizes a cherazad has frozen the battle.
timeline.quote: "Tactical event horizon," he realizes.

timeline.summary: Sami opens the stasis cask and Mirri trots out beside the Endstone.
timeline.quote: A cat trots out of the dark.

timeline.summary: Alpharael drops the crystal on the map and it settles at the edge of the rag and the system.
timeline.quote: It bounces twice and settles on the very edge of the reading rag, and the solar system, too.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret says they will warp until the stone says it has reached its goal.
timeline.quote: We will see what god or monster made this thing.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret toasts the success of taking a piece of the unknown.
timeline.quote: We have taken a piece of the unknown.

timeline.summary: The Endstone changes into a black ovoid and points at Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: The stone has lost its glistening facets. It is now a gleamingly black ovoid.

timeline.summary: The Endstone falls into the visitor's hand after Alpharael drops it.
timeline.quote: The Endstone falls into its hand.

timeline.summary: The visitor says Alpharael is touched by the core and he collapses unconscious.
timeline.quote: Touched by the core. Blessed …

timeline.summary: Alpharael has strange dreams since his sister dove into the supervoid.
timeline.quote: He has been plagued by strange dreams ever since his sister embraced eternity and dove into the supervoid.

relations.quote: Why did they choose you when we are the same, identical but for our sex?

relations.note: Alpharael's sister, chosen for the Plummet.
relations.quote: "My sister's not a heretic," Alpharael protests.

relations.note: Zagachoir comforts Alpharael and asks him for help taking sekhar.
The Free Company's palestar tried to shoot down the fighter Alpharael stole.
relations.quote: No wonder they were shooting at him.

relations.note: Sami identifies Alpharael as a Monoist.

relations.quote: All he will say is that they are going to find and kill Alpharael.

relations.note: Haliya blames Alpharael for Vondam's wound.
relations.quote: She let the coward Alpharael throw a black hole through her knight's skull.
shot from his artificial womb alongside his twin sister

relations.note: The object chooses Alpharael as its wielder.
relations.quote: Do you understand, Alpharael, why you were meant to wield me?
I want to use it so that my sister never took the Plummet.

relations.note: Haliya says she needs someone to protect.
relations.quote: I need somebody to protect, or I don't know what to do.

pages_say.description: A Monoist acolyte who loses his sister Raphaella to the Plummet, volunteers for the assault on the Dawnsire and takes sekhar.

A young Monoist acolyte from Susur Secundi who follows his sister toward the Plummet, joins a boarding party against the Dawnsire, kills no knight but throws away his sekhar to live, and is spared by Captain Slats.
A young Monoist who crashes a stolen Sunstar Hopelight into Kavaron, is rescued by Sami and Tannuk, and begins to fall upward after touching the Metalman's artifact.
A Monoist whose crashed Hopelight irradiated the Kav team; he lies comatose in a locked cabin after touching the stone, with a hole in his right palm.
A fugitive Monoist who wakes on the Seriema with a hole through his right hand, hears the voice of the object, and has the stone's help in escape.
A Monoist who paralyzes Haliya with an injector through the hole in his hand and joins the Seriema.
A Monoist apostate with a hole in his hand who wants to live, bonds uneasily with Haliya, and joins Sami's plan to escape Sothera.
A Monoist apostate who broadcasts a plea to the Monoists and tries to guess a warp ferry code with Haliya.
A Monoist apostate whose hole-pierced hand helps Haliya disable Vondam and who is struck down by the Endstone's visitor.
A young Monoist acolyte plagued by dreams since his sister dove into the supervoid, tasked with a likely suicide mission against the Sunstar Free Company.
